items.reason: Gap 0 says two concurrent deliveries both pass the in-memory check before either inserts, because the check and the insert are not atomic.
Gap 1 says the dedup key comes from the unsigned X-Event-Id header and can be spoofed.
Gap 3 says the provider sends charge.refunded while the handler is registered as refund.created, so refunds are not recorded.
No gap depends on multiple processes, and gap 0 concerns concurrency within the single process's queue.
